records.localization_note: Keep the short Hodram Bergstrom nameplate and the full Hodram Joakim Bergstrom catalogue form.
Cristina Erneco is the name of the crewmate who steps into the mutiny alongside Al Shin.
Yukihisa Shiraki identifies Muramasa, offers Al Shin formal aid, and later comments on loyalty.
Gerhard Adernkatz is the named officer who reports on the prisoners, recognizes the recovered object, and warns Hodram.
Keep Al Shin in the header. Yukihisa and Hodram use Al in direct address, as in the Japanese.
Charles Rochefort is the short form. The alternate prisoner report and his excited response to the mutineers use that header.
Manuel Almeida gives one of the prisoner reports and delivers the three-part elegy.
Aziza Nurennahar introduces her full name in the retreat. She explicitly asks to be called Aziza after joining.
Barbarossa Hayreddin is the established name of the captain issuing the Caribbean challenge.
Julian Vermeer is the man Hodram stops and later takes to Sao Jorge.
Plett Perrault is the named fugitive in the confrontation and Hangzhou transfer.
Jean Ramusio is the trader called out by Gerhard. Hodram mentions the Basra guild after the encounter.
Jacob Portunto is named in the smuggling exchange and keeps the same identity on the Calicut transfer.
William Clive is the named pirate whose distinctive laughter and repeated threats remain in his dialogue.
Hernan Berio is the established name of the opponent who boasts that others flee at sight of him.
Iscal Yasar is the opponent named in the king's order and keeps the same header when he accepts.
Sailor is the source role. The crew's cheers introduce no individual name or shipboard rank.
Angel is Aziza's crew member, named when she gives the steering order and identified by the same control in the mutiny.
Snake is Aziza's crew member, named when she gives a command and identified by the same control in the mutiny.
Dandy is Aziza's gunner in the confrontation and the same man who names the price for her release.
